evidence.locator: 1138 rear cicn -9975 is 23x16 with opaque x2..20 and cinf corner10; 1990 rear cicn -9975 is 32x16 with opaque x1..28 and cinf corner14. Applying those original corner sizes after opaque cropping yields middle widths -1 and 0.
evidence.claim: Original source corner coordinates must not be applied to a smaller cropped source extent.
evidence.limits: Does not establish complete historical tab drawer or font.

evidence.locator: CDEF 8 reads the full cicn PixMap bounds at 0x420..0x42a, copies full-height end strips at 0x430..0x47e, and paints independent top/bottom bands at 0x484..0x552. When cinf tileSides is zero, 0x4a2..0x4b4 and 0x506..0x518 reduce the band source to its first column. 1138 rear art is 23x16 with corner10/side10; 1990 rear is 32x16 with corner14/side14. Both have empty centers and overlapping bands, so preserving full source coordinates retains their middle strips without repeating the adjacent semantic sample column.
evidence.claim: Full source coordinates and first-column bands retain the middle strips in the two exact unselected AgjpQy cases.
evidence.limits: Tests compare body pixels outside the current browser glyph mask; separate empty-label/literal fixtures cover whole body coordinates. Expected archive catalog bindings are not actual tab paint traces. Original selection, font, layout, device/transfer and pattern-center behavior remain unknown.

evidence.locator: - Selection (0x7de, 0x8d2–0x956, 0xcc2–0xce0): state 0 for hilite 254/255 or a zero per-tab enabled byte (0xdb4–0xdc4), else 1; tracking toggles 1 and 2 (0x117a–0x11a8); +3 when the tab index equals the control value; the small variant draws -9976+state and the large variant -9984+state.
evidence.claim: Per-tab state 0 (hilite 254/255 or a zero per-tab enabled byte) or 1, tracking 1<->2, +3 for the selected tab; small variant draws -9976+state, large -9984+state.
evidence.limits: Which public or caller action produces each hilite, enabled byte and variant is not established; composeTab has no disabled, pressed or variant option.

evidence.locator: - Fallback (0x16e, 0x914, 0x950): the painter returns false only when its icon is NULL (0x18c–0x194), and only then does the caller probe -9960+state (small) or -9968+state (large); a found icon without same-id cinf returns true and draws nothing (0x38e to 0x622).
evidence.claim: Only a NULL icon makes 0x16e return false and the caller probe -9960+state / -9968+state; a found icon without cinf draws nothing.
evidence.limits: Probe order only; the resource file that answers each probe is not established.

evidence.locator: - Fallback colours (0x1ba–0x376): helper 0x263a is GetResource('clut'). States 0–4 of both fallback ladders (-9968..-9964, -9960..-9956; -9963..-9961 and -9955 are not recoloured) get icon colour-table entries from clut -14336 (ids -9964/-9967/-9956/-9959) or clut -14335 (-9965/-9968/-9957/-9960). The pressed ids -9966/-9958 also sample two colours from cicn -10238 at cinf -10238 (or cinf 0) points through 0x1bce. Before GetCIcon, 0x16e makes the Gestalt('Copl') file current (0x198–0x1b8). The 2.3.1 control-panel fork (installer-component identity, same chain as CDEF 8) ships cicn and cinf for exactly those ten ids plus clut -14336/-14335; all 18 archives also ship both cluts. Which file and which clut copy answer at draw time is not established.
evidence.claim: States 0-4 of both fallback ladders (-9968..-9964, -9960..-9956) are recoloured from clut -14336/-14335 (0x263a is GetResource clut); pressed ids -9966/-9958 also sample cicn -10238. The 2.3.1 control-panel fork ships cicn and cinf for those ten ids and both cluts; all 18 archives ship both cluts; 0x16e makes the Gestalt(Copl) file current before GetCIcon.
evidence.limits: Installer-component identity only: the 2.3.1 control-panel fork ships them; the runtime resource chain at draw time and which clut copy is used are not established.

evidence.locator: - Body (0x16e, 0x394–0x61e): c = cinf[0] is horizontal and s = cinf[1] vertical. Full-height c-column ends are drawn first (0x430–0x47e). Then come the top and bottom s-row bands over destination x [c, W−c), tiled forward from source x [c, w−c), or from the single column c when cinf[2] is zero (0x484–0x552). Last, the centre [c, W−c)×[s, H−s) is erased in the raw background sample when cinf+4 is zero (0x558–0x600). The output height is the source height (0x614–0x61e).
evidence.claim: Full-height c-column ends, then top/bottom s-row bands (single column c when cinf[2] is zero), then the centre erased in the raw background sample when cinf+4 is zero; output height = source height.
evidence.limits: Width-one bands use the sampled-line path (0x1f10-0x1f86); raster colours stand in only under an equivalent sampling record. Pattern centre phase, device transfer and custom port procedures are not decoded.

requirements.claim: Do not lose the middle strip by mixing original corner sizes with opaque-cropped source extents.

For the public composeTab rows (selected false/true, empty label) draw the art CDEF 8 selects over the archive's own fork: small-variant id -9976+state, state 1 resting enabled plus 3 for the selected tab (0x7de, 0x8d2-0x956, 0xcc2-0xce0), under the declared public-to-native mapping.
Choose the small or large variant as (data+32)&7 does, and after a NULL icon probe -9960+state (small) or -9968+state (large) as 0x914/0x950 do.

At the output width, paint the selected raster as 0x16e does: full-height c-column ends, then masked top/bottom s-row bands over [c, W-c) from the first middle column (cinf[2] zero) or the full middle (0x430-0x552).
Size each tab Rect as the CDEF 8 caller does: StringWidth+24, plus 20 with an icon (0x856-0x8a8).
Draw the tab pane (-9977/-9969 active, -9978/-9970 inactive) with the tabs as the original caller does.
Fill the centre [c, W-c)x[s, H-s) with the raw background sample when cinf+4 is zero (0x558-0x600); otherwise with that ppat at the decoded phase.
Draw disabled (state 0/3), pressed (2/5) and per-tab-disabled tabs with the ids 0xcc2-0xce0, 0xdb4-0xdc4 and 0x117a-0x11a8 select.
